text: VideoAgent Product Requirements Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.4 Updated 2026-11-04 1. Product Goal VideoAgent helps a creator act as the director: describe an idea, select a skill or production setting, generate controllable shots, review the result, and keep finished or in-progress work organized in one workspace. Every primary view is organized around a concrete creation, review, publishing, search, or asset-management task. 2. Target Users - Independent video creators. - Product and brand marketing teams. - Social media operators. - Short-drama and narrative creators. - Users who need controllable video generation across multiple model providers. 3. Navigation Desktop navigation is fixed on the left in this order: Agents Skills Hots Assets Docs The account controls are fixed in the upper-right in this order: Language Notifications Credits Avatar The account-control container has no outer border. Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. Their menus open downward and use the same translucent treatment. The avatar opens login and registration when signed out. When signed in, it shows the account email and a sign-out action. 4. Agents - The home view contains a prominent prompt composer. - The composer supports skill, hook, style, frame, duration, model, quality, audio, and review settings. - The Model selector lists every currently available video model and labels each option with its Pippit or Kling provider. - The prompt editor grows downward as wrapped text or line count increases. - Idea prompts are visible only when the prompt is empty; production playbooks remain available for switching. - A user can select a Skill before starting. - Composer setting menus open above or below the trigger based on viewport space and remain inside the visible area. - Production playbooks provide one-click starting points for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. - Applying a playbook fills the prompt and sets its recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. - Selecting the active playbook again cancels it and restores the composer state that existed before the playbook was applied. - Submitting creates a project and enters the project workspace. - The VideoAgent headline and icon stream together. 5. Skills 5.1 Catalogue Skills use one flat catalogue with task-oriented cards. Official skill IDs use: video agent/<skill id Examples: video agent/search all resources video agent/text to video video agent/image to video video agent/reference to video video agent/first last frame video agent/motion control video agent/video extend video agent/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same skill-card structure as other task-oriented Skills. 5.2 Search and Publishing - Skills has a top search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search matches user ID, skill ID, title, and description. - A user can publish a skill using the same publish interaction pattern used by Hots. - User-published IDs follow <user id /<skill id . 6. Hots - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Cards play muted looping video. - Each card shows the title first and author and likes below. - Each scenario card opens Agents with its prompt and corresponding Skill. - Users can publish a post from the feed. - Search matches title, author, and prompt. 7. Assets Assets contains the current user's finished and in-progress work. - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Cards are arranged as a waterfall. - Internal Video and Skill tabs separate the two asset types; cards do not repeat type labels. - Each card shows permission: private or public . - Edit time uses yyyy-mm-dd . - Duration, progress, and summary are not shown. - Video cards play a muted loop on hover and pause when hover ends. Skill cards have no cover image. 8. Docs Document order: PRD Design Interface Impl Test Ops FAQ TODO English labels and Chinese short labels: English Chinese --- --- PRD 产品 Design 设计 Interface 接口 Impl 实现 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 Docs requirements: - A search field is available at the top. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search covers document text in both languages. - The language control changes only Docs. - The left table of contents supports navigation, highlighting, and collapse. - English and Chinese versions use the same document order. - The Docs area uses a fixed dark theme without a theme toggle. 9. Authentication and Credits - Users authenticate with email and password. - Credentials are stored only as cryptographic hashes. - Sessions use HttpOnly cookies. - The upper-right credit count reflects the active server provider. - Generation requires explicit approval before a billable provider call. 10. Non-Functional Requirements - Desktop and mobile layouts must avoid clipped controls. - All primary controls must be keyboard accessible. - Motion supports prefers-reduced-motion . - Search and filtering run in the client. 11. Acceptance Criteria 1. Navigation order is Agents, Skills, Hots, Assets, Docs. 2. Agents can choose a Skill. 3. Skills is one searchable flat catalogue using user id/skill id . 4. Official Skills use the video agent namespace. 5. Users can publish a Skill. 6. Review appears as a normal Skill card. 7. Hots and Assets both provide top search. 8. Hots cards play video and show title above author and likes. 9. Assets uses internal Video and Skill tabs and shows permission and yyyy-mm-dd edit time. 10. Assets uses a waterfall layout; videos preview on hover and Skill cards have no cover. 11. Docs includes PRD, Design, Interface, Impl, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO in order. 12. Docs search and bilingual switching work. 13. Avatar provides login, registration, or sign-out based on session state. 14. Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended production settings. 15. Hots scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill selected. 16. The prompt grows with its content and empty-state suggestions disappear while typing. 17. Re-clicking the active playbook cancels selection and restores the previous draft. 18. The Model selector exposes all available video models.

text: VideoAgent 产品需求文档 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.4 更新日期 2026-11-04 1. 产品目标 VideoAgent 帮助用户以导演身份完成视频创作：描述想法、选择 Skill 或制作设定、 生成可控镜头、评估结果，并在同一工作台中管理成品与半成品。 每个主页面围绕明确的选择、创建、搜索、发布、评估或资产管理任务组织。 2. 目标用户 - 独立视频创作者。 - 产品与品牌营销团队。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 短剧和叙事内容创作者。 - 需要跨多个模型服务进行可控视频生成的用户。 3. 导航 桌面端左侧导航顺序固定为： Agents Skills Hots Assets Docs 账户操作固定在右上角，视觉顺序为： 语言 通知 积分 头像 账户操作组不显示外边框。 搜索框、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面；点击后的菜单向下展开， 并保持半透明。 头像在未登录时提供登录和注册入口，登录后显示账户邮箱和退出操作。 4. Agents - 首页提供醒目的创作输入框。 - 创作框支持 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长、模型、清晰度、音频和审核设定。 - 模型选择器展示全部当前可用的视频模型，并标注 Pippit 或 Kling Provider。 - 输入框随文字行数或自动换行向下扩展。 - 示例灵感仅在输入框为空时显示，创作 Playbook 保持可用并可切换。 - 用户可以在开始创作前选择一个 Skill。 - 创作设定的菜单根据视口剩余空间自动向上或向下展开，并始终限制在可视区域内。 - 创作场景提供产品广告、创作者 Vlog、微短剧、音乐 MV、视频本地化和批量测款的一键起点。 - 选择创作场景后，自动填入提示词，并设置推荐的 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长与审核方式。 - 再次点击当前已选中的 Playbook 可取消选择，并恢复应用该 Playbook 前的创作状态。 - 提交后创建项目并进入项目工作区。 - VideoAgent 主标题和播放键图标同时参与流式输出。 5. Skills 5.1 Skill 目录 Skills 使用统一目录，并以任务型卡片组织。 官方 Skill ID 格式： video agent/<skill id 示例： video agent/search all resources video agent/text to video video agent/image to video video agent/reference to video video agent/first last frame video agent/motion control video agent/video extend video agent/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review 使用与其他任务型 Skill 一致的卡片结构。 5.2 搜索与发布 - Skills 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索范围包含 user id、skill id、标题和描述。 - 用户可以通过与 Hots 发布一致的方式发布 Skill。 - 用户发布 ID 使用 <user id /<skill id 格式。 6. Hots - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 卡片使用循环播放的视频。 - 标题在上，作者和喜欢数在下。 - 场景卡片可带着对应 Skill 和提示词进入 Agents。 - 用户可以从社区流发布作品。 - 搜索范围包含标题、作者和 Prompt。 7. Assets Assets 展示当前用户的成品和半成品。 - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 卡片以瀑布流排布。 - 使用 Video 和 Skill 两个内部分页区分类型，不在每张卡片上重复类型标签。 - 必须展示权限： private 或 public 。 - 编辑时间统一使用 yyyy-mm-dd 。 - 不展示时长、进度和摘要。 - Video 卡片悬浮时静音循环播放，移开后暂停并回到开始；Skill 卡片不显示封面。 8. Docs 文档顺序： PRD Design Interface Impl Test Ops FAQ TODO 中文缩写： 英文 中文 --- --- PRD 产品 Design 设计 Interface 接口 Impl 实现 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 文档要求： - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索覆盖中英文文档正文。 - 语言按钮切换文档语言。 - 左侧目录支持跳转、高亮和折叠。 - 中英文版本保持相同文档顺序。 - 文档使用统一的深色阅读主题。 9. 认证与积分 - 用户通过邮箱和密码登录。 - 密码仅保存加密哈希。 - 会话使用 HttpOnly Cookie。 - 右上角积分来自当前服务端 Provider。 - 任何可能计费的生成请求都必须先获得用户明确批准。 10. 非功能要求 - 桌面端和移动端不得出现控件遮挡。 - 所有核心控件应支持键盘操作。 - 动效支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 搜索和筛选在客户端完成。 11. 验收标准 1. 导航顺序为 Agents、Skills、Hots、Assets、Docs。 2. Agents 可以选择 Skill。 3. Skills 使用统一的可搜索目录，并显示 user id/skill id 。 4. 官方 Skill 使用 video agent 命名空间。 5. 用户可以发布 Skill。 6. Review 使用统一 Skill 卡片。 7. Hots 和 Assets 均提供顶部搜索。 8. Hots 卡片自动播放，标题位于作者与喜欢数上方。 9. Assets 通过 Video/Skill 内部分页区分类型，并展示权限和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 10. Assets 使用瀑布流；Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片不显示封面。 11. Docs 依次包含 PRD、Design、Interface、Impl、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO。 12. Docs 搜索和双语切换可用。 13. 头像根据登录状态提供登录、注册或退出。 14. 创作 Playbook 可填充提示词和推荐制作参数。 15. Hots 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill。 16. 输入框随内容向下扩展，输入内容后空态建议隐藏。 17. 重复点击已激活的 Playbook 会取消选择，并恢复应用前的草稿。 18. 模型下拉框展示全部可用视频模型。

text: VideoAgent Software Design Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.6 Updated 2026-11-04 Backend Python + FastAPI Frontend Next.js + TypeScript Model Seedance 2.5 Draft (Pippit), Seedance 2.5 (Pippit), Seedance 2.0 Fast VIP (Pippit), Seedance 2.0 VIP (Pippit), Seedance 2.0 Mini Preview (Pippit), Seedance 2.0 Mini (Pippit), Wan 3.0 (Pippit), HappyHorse 1.1 (Pippit), Kling Video 2.5 (Kling), Kling Video 2.6 (Kling), Kling Video O1 (Kling), Kling Video 3.0 (Kling), Kling Video 3.0 Omni (Kling), Kling Video 3.0 Turbo (Kling), Kling Video 4.0 (Kling), Kling 2.6 Motion Control (Kling), Kling 3.0 Motion Control (Kling), Kling Image 3.0 Omni (Kling), Kling Image O1 (Kling), Kling Image 3.0 (Kling), Kling Image 2.1 (Kling) VideoAgent integrates Pippit CLI and Kling MCP behind one provider boundary. Pippit provides video submission, task queries, and credits. Kling MCP provides text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference tools. 1. Purpose This document describes VideoAgent's product architecture, core modules, directing workflow, data model, API contracts, provider integrations, security, testing, and deployment. 2. Product Overview VideoAgent is a director-oriented AI video workspace. The public navigation contains five isolated views: - Agents: home creation composer and VideoAgent conversations. - Skills: one searchable catalogue of generation, workflow, and review skills. - Assets: a waterfall library of the user's videos and skills with permission and edit time; videos preview on hover and skills have no cover. - Hots: community feed with author, likes, playback, and publishing. - Docs: embedded bilingual documentation with a collapsible table of contents. 3. Scope 3.1 Product Baseline - Left navigation with shared visual and icon behavior. - Home composer with a Skill selector, seven production settings, and custom translucent dropdowns. - Project creation, listing, reading, renaming, and archival. - User ownership isolation. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - Configurable OpenAI-compatible planner with deterministic local fallback. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Cost estimation and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI text-to-video submission, task polling, and credit query. - Kling MCP text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference capabilities. - Mock Provider and Celery polling. - Instant storyboard review for consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing. - Hots feed playback, author, likes, and publishing. - English and Chinese documentation generated from paired Markdown sources. 4. Core User Flow Sign in → describe an idea in the home composer → choose style, frame, length, model, quality, audio, and review mode → create a default project → enter the project workspace → plan a storyboard with VideoAgent → estimate cost and approve generation → poll the generation job → review the storyboard → continue editing or prepare the next generation 5. Current Architecture Browser ├── Next.js product UI │ ├── shared Landing UI │ ├── embedded Docs │ └── project workspace Next.js Route Handler /api/account/ → FastAPI /api/v1 ├── Auth / Projects / Storyboards ├── Agent / Generation / Evaluation / Providers ├── SQLAlchemy Async ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling MCP Celery Worker + Redis → Pippit / Kling task status 6. Technology Stack Area Current technology --- --- Web Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5.9 UI Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide, shared Landing CSS Localization next-intl routing and translation resources Client state React page state API FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2 Agent LangGraph, LangChain OpenAI-compatible provider Database SQLAlchemy 2 Async, SQLite Jobs Celery with Redis Video providers Pippit CLI, Kling MCP, Mock Provider Testing pytest, Vitest, Testing Library Quality Ruff, mypy, TypeScript 7. Agent Design The directing workflow uses an explicit LangGraph state machine: START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard receives locale, project title, project brief, and the latest user message. It returns an assistant message and a validated three-shot storyboard. The planner is: - OpenAI-compatible when VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY and VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL are configured. - Deterministic and local otherwise. Project, conversation, storyboard, Shot, and GenerationJob state live in the database. Approval, generation, review, and polling boundaries are coordinated through FastAPI, Celery, and the workspace client. 8. Generation and Provider Boundary POST /shots/{id}/estimate → VideoProvider.estimate POST /shots/{id}/generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → VideoProvider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → Celery polling GET /jobs/{id} → VideoProvider.status when not terminal → update GenerationJob and Shot The VideoProvider protocol exposes estimate , submit , and status . 8.1 Pippit CLI The service runs pippit-tool-cli through argument arrays and does not use shell string interpolation. Current commands include: status get-credit-balance generate-video query-result The server owns CLI authorization. All product users share the configured Pippit account and credit pool. Access keys and CLI session files never reach the browser. 8.2 Kling MCP Kling MCP exposes text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame, motion control, and Omni-Ref tools. OAuth is managed by the connector. The provider adapter maps task state, errors, and result URLs into the shared VideoProvider contract so the project workflow does not depend on protocol or vendor details. 9. Skills Catalogue Skills use one flat, searchable catalogue. Every card shows its user id/skill id identifier at the upper left. Official skills use the video agent namespace. Skill ID Input and result --- --- video agent/search all resources Search projects, videos, skills, Hots, and Docs video agent/text to video Text prompt to one video clip video agent/image to video Still image to controlled motion video agent/reference to video Image, video, or audio references to a generated clip video agent/first last frame Opening and closing frames to a continuous transition video agent/motion control Driving-video motion applied to a subject image video agent/video extend Continue an existing clip video agent/video edit Prompt-directed modification of existing footage video agent/style transfer Apply a reference style while preserving structure and motion video agent/video upscale Raise video resolution up to 4K video agent/product film A composed product-video workflow video agent/creator vlog A composed creator-vlog workflow video agent/short drama A composed short-drama workflow video agent/review Score consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing video agent/video localization Adapt edit, copy, voice, and presenter details for a target market video agent/batch variants Generate a controlled matrix of hooks, scenes, and messaging variants video agent/script assistant Develop premises into editable scripts with characters, beats, and hooks video agent/smart preview Prepare keyframes and an animatic before final shot generation video agent/camera movement Select and combine purposeful camera moves video agent/music video Plan performance, visual motifs, and beat-synced editing video agent/reference remake Deconstruct a reference and rebuild its structure with new footage video agent/agent handoff Package project context and assets for an external Agent via MCP or CLI Review uses the same task-oriented card structure as other Skills. Selecting a skill preloads a concrete prompt in the Agents composer. The Agents composer also includes a Skill selector. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own <user id /<skill id namespace. The Model selector uses the verified live catalogue: seven Kling video models and eight Pippit video models, plus Auto. Provider names are part of every option label so users can distinguish model families. The Agents composer includes production playbooks for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. Selecting a playbook sets the prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode as one coherent starting point. Playbooks use toggle behavior: selecting the active playbook again restores the pre-playbook draft. Hook controls the first-three-second strategy: visual impact, narrative twist, spoken hook, sound cue, or proof first. 10. Data Model Table Purpose --- --- users Account, password hash, and locale preference sessions Hashed server-side session tokens projects Project metadata and owner storyboards One current storyboard per project shots Ordered prompts, duration, frame, mode, and status conversations One conversation per project messages User and assistant messages generation jobs Provider task, idempotency key, status, result provider connections Provider authorization metadata oauth flows OAuth transaction state 11. API Surface Base path: /api/v1 Area Endpoints --- --- Health GET /health Auth Register, login, logout, current user Projects List, create, read, rename, archive Storyboards GET and PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard Agent Get messages, send a message Evaluation POST /projects/{id}/evaluate Generation Estimate, submit, job status Providers Pippit status and credits Agent responses and job status use regular JSON with polling. 12. Frontend Design The shared Landing UI owns: - Left navigation and responsive layout. - Continuous background carousel with no inter-frame gap. - Streaming hero title and blue play brand mark. - Custom transparent composer dropdowns. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue with user publishing. - Hots masonry feed with looping muted video playback. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs; videos preview on hover and Skill cards omit cover images. - Searchable embedded Docs with a collapsible table of contents. - Semi-transparent search, language, notification, credit, and avatar controls. - Viewport-aware composer menus that flip above the trigger when needed, plus downward-opening language, notification, account, and search menus. - Avatar account actions for login, registration, and sign-out. 13. Documentation Language - The globe button beside notifications controls documentation language. - English documents are generated as .html . - Chinese documents are generated as .zh.html . - Document tabs are PRD , Design , Interface , Impl , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . 14. Security and Reliability - Session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax. - Cross-user resources return 404 . - Provider commands use argument arrays and timeouts. - Generation submissions use database idempotency keys. - The database is the source of truth for project, shot, and job state. 15. Deployment Local development: Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite Pippit CLI or Kling MCP Celery + Redis 16. Acceptance Baseline 1. Users can create, rename, and archive their own projects. 2. VideoAgent creates a validated multi-shot storyboard. 3. Cost and approval are visible before generation. 4. Jobs and storyboards survive a page refresh or API restart. 5. Provider credentials never reach the browser. 6. Review returns consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing. 7. Skills is a flat searchable catalogue using user id/skill id , with workflows and Review presented as normal skill cards. 8. Documentation switches between English and Chinese and follows the complete eight-document order. 9. Production playbooks and Skill-backed Hots scenarios provide editable, reusable starting points. 10. The prompt editor grows with stacked or wrapped content, and empty-state suggestions hide as soon as non-whitespace input exists.

text: VideoAgent 软件设计说明书 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.6 更新日期 2026-11-04 后端技术 Python + FastAPI 前端技术 Next.js + TypeScript 模型 Seedance 2.5 Draft（Pippit）、Seedance 2.5（Pippit）、Seedance 2.0 Fast VIP（Pippit）、Seedance 2.0 VIP（Pippit）、Seedance 2.0 Mini 体验版（Pippit）、Seedance 2.0 Mini（Pippit）、Wan 3.0（Pippit）、HappyHorse 1.1（Pippit）、Kling Video 2.5（Kling）、Kling Video 2.6（Kling）、Kling Video O1（Kling）、Kling Video 3.0（Kling）、Kling Video 3.0 Omni（Kling）、Kling Video 3.0 Turbo（Kling）、Kling Video 4.0（Kling）、Kling 2.6 Motion Control（Kling）、Kling 3.0 Motion Control（Kling）、Kling Image 3.0 Omni（Kling）、Kling Image O1（Kling）、Kling Image 3.0（Kling）、Kling Image 2.1（Kling） VideoAgent 通过统一 Provider 边界集成 Pippit CLI 与 Kling MCP。Pippit 提供视频提交、任务查询和积分能力，Kling MCP 提供文本生成视频、图生视频、动作控制和多模态参考能力。 1. 文档目的 本文档描述 VideoAgent 的产品目标、系统架构、核心模块、Agent 编排、数据模型、接口规范、Pippit CLI 与 Kling MCP 集成、安全策略、测试策略及部署方式，供产品、前端、后端、测试和运维研发人员共同参考。 2. 产品概述 VideoAgent 是一个面向内容创作者、营销人员和普通用户的 AI 视频创作平台。产品以“用户是导演”为核心，通过统一的左侧工作台进入 Agents、Skills、Hots、Assets 和 Docs；用户从首页创作框描述创意后创建项目，进入项目工作区与 VideoAgent 协作生成故事板并发起镜头生成。 系统同时提供： - Agents： 首页创作入口和项目内 VideoAgent 对话。 - Skills： 单一可搜索 Skill 目录，使用 user id/skill id 标识，并支持用户发布。 - Hots： 可搜索社区作品流，展示作者、喜欢数并支持发布。 - Assets： 用户成品与半成品作品库，按 Video/Skill 分页；视频悬浮预览，Skill 不显示封面。 - Docs： 八份中英文文档、全文搜索、统一深色阅读主题和左侧可折叠目录。 创作范式结合对话式生成、模板化制作和多模型工作台组织方式。生成能力通过统一 Provider 契约接入，使项目、故事板、镜头和任务状态不依赖单一模型服务。 3. 产品目标与范围 3.1 MVP 目标 - 首页采用左侧导航、连续视频背景、居中创作框、场景 Playbook、Hook 控制和自定义透明下拉控件。 - 创作输入框随内容行数自动向下增高；示例灵感仅在输入为空时显示，Playbook 保持可切换。 - 模型选择器使用实时核验目录：Kling 7 个视频模型、Pippit 8 个视频模型，另有 Auto。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面，相关菜单向下展开；创作框选项菜单根据视口空间自动向上或向下展开并限制高度；头像支持登录、注册和退出。 - Hots 展示作者与喜欢数，并支持发布。 - 支持项目创建、编辑、恢复和删除。 - 支持 Agent 生成创意方案和多镜头故事板。 - 支持镜头参数编辑和积分成本估算。 - 支持故事板即时评估，计算一致性、覆盖度、提示清晰度和节奏。 - 支持服务端统一授权的 Pippit CLI。 - 支持 Pippit 文本生成视频、任务查询和积分余额读取。 - 支持 Kling MCP 的文本生成视频、图生视频、动作控制和多模态参考能力。 - 支持 Celery 后台轮询与前端任务状态轮询。 - 保证 Provider Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 MCP 凭据不暴露给浏览器。 4. 用户与核心场景 4.1 目标用户 - 普通内容创作者。 - 电商和产品营销人员。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 广告创意和短视频制作人员。 4.2 核心用户流程 登录 → 在首页多设定创作框描述创意 → 提交时自动创建默认项目 → 直接进入项目工作区 → Agent 追问并生成创意方案 → 编辑故事板和镜头 → 查看预计积分 → 确认生成 → 查看生成进度 → 审核并重新生成镜头 → 继续编辑或准备下一轮生成 5. 总体架构 5.1 注册、登录、会话和用户信息 api.projects 项目生命周期和权限 api.storyboards 故事板读取和整体替换 api.agent 消息读取、消息发送和故事板规划 api.generation 积分估算、生成提交和任务状态刷新 api.evaluation 故事板即时评估 api.providers Pippit 服务端状态和积分余额 api.health API 与数据库健康检查 Celery 任务轮询 9. Agent 设计 9.1 基本策略 Agent 使用一个主 Agent 和一个确定性节点，不采用无限制 ReAct 循环，也不将相互耦合的创作职责拆成多个自由对话 Agent。 - LangGraph 负责故事板规划。 - 配置 LLM 时由 LangChain OpenAI-compatible Provider 执行模型调用；未配置时使用本地确定性规划器。 - Pydantic 校验模型输出和工具参数。 - Celery 执行 Provider 任务轮询。 - 项目、对话、故事板和生成任务保存到关系数据库。 Agent 图： START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard 接收项目标题、Brief、用户消息和 Locale，输出 assistant message 与三镜头故事板，并同步持久化消息和故事板。 10. LangGraph 与 Celery 职责边界： - LangGraph 只生成故事板计划。 - Celery 轮询 Provider 任务。 - 数据库保存项目、故事板、镜头和生成任务的最终状态。 生成流程： 1. LangGraph 或用户操作创建镜头和故事板。 2. 用户批准生成。 3. FastAPI 创建数据库任务和本地幂等键。 4. Provider 适配器提交任务。 5. 保存标准化任务引用。 6. Celery 轮询任务状态。 7. 前端每 5 秒请求 GET /jobs/{job id} 触发状态刷新。 8. 更新 Job、Shot 和 Provider 原始响应。 具备不确定性的提交不能自动重发。提交超时但未获得 Provider Task ID 时，任务进入 submission uncertain ，通过查询账户近期任务进行人工或自动对账。 11. Provider 集成 11.1 Pippit CLI 运维在 API 主机安装 Pippit CLI → 运维执行 pippit-tool-cli login → CLI 将设备凭据保存到操作系统安全存储 → 或 CI 注入 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY → FastAPI 通过受限子进程调用 CLI → 读取 Pippit 账户状态和积分 Pippit 授权由服务端统一持有。Provider 层负责积分读取、生成提交、任务查询和结果标准化。 11.2 Provider 接口 class VideoProvider(Protocol): name: str async def estimate(self, request: GenerationRequest) - CostEstimate: ... async def submit(self, request: GenerationRequest) - ProviderJob: ... async def status(self, job id: str) - ProviderJob: ... 11.3 Pippit 能力 pippit-tool-cli status pippit-tool-cli get-credit-balance pippit-tool-cli generate-video pippit-tool-cli query-result Provider 使用参数数组启动 CLI，不经过 Shell 字符串拼接；stdout 仅接受 JSON，stderr 和完整命令参数不返回到浏览器。 模型与分辨率由服务端环境变量可选配置，留空时使用 CLI 服务的默认值。 11.4 Kling MCP Kling MCP 通过统一工具调用边界暴露视频能力： - 文本生成视频。 - 图生视频与首尾帧。 - 动作控制。 - Omni-Ref 多模态参考。 - 任务查询和结果 URL 解析。 MCP OAuth 由连接器管理，工具调用参数使用结构化对象。Provider 适配器将 Kling 的任务状态、错误和结果映射到与 Pippit 相同的 VideoProvider 契约， 上层项目工作流无需感知具体厂商协议。 11.5 凭据与进程安全 - CLI 登录文件由操作系统安全存储管理，不写入仓库或数据库。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 仅作为服务端秘密环境变量注入子进程。 - 浏览器、API 响应和日志均不返回 Access Key。 - CLI 命令使用 asyncio.create subprocess exec 的参数数组形式执行。 - 子进程受超时控制；超时后终止进程，不自动重提计费任务。 - Web 进程必须只允许受信用户触发生成，并在调用前执行显式审批。 12. 数据模型 表 关键字段 说明 --- --- --- users id , email , locale , status 用户和语言偏好 sessions id , user id , expires at 服务端会话 projects id , owner id , title , state , brief 视频项目 conversations id , project id 项目对话 messages id , role , content , metadata 对话消息 storyboards id , project id , version 每个项目唯一的当前故事板 shots id , storyboard id , index , prompt en , prompt zh , status 镜头定义 provider connections id , user id , provider , encrypted tokens Provider 授权信息 oauth flows id , state hash , provider , expires at OAuth 事务状态 generation jobs id , shot id , idempotency key , provider task id , status 生成任务与 Provider 原始响应 统一使用 UUID 主键、UTC 时间戳和数据库外键。数据库使用通用 JSON 字段保存 Provider 原始响应。 13. 核心状态定义 13.1 项目状态 draft planning awaiting plan approval generating review assembling completed failed archived 13.2 镜头状态 draft ready queued generating completed failed cancelled 13.3 生成任务状态 pending submission uncertain submitted queued running succeeded failed cancelled 14. API 设计 14.1 通用规范 - 基础路径： /api/v1 。 - 认证：HttpOnly 服务端会话 Cookie。 - 成功响应使用 JSON。 - 错误统一返回稳定错误码。 - 项目列表一次性返回。 - 生成写操作要求 Idempotency-Key 请求头。 - OpenAPI 是前后端接口契约。 统一错误响应： { "error": { "code": "GENERATION APPROVAL REQUIRED", "message": "Generation requires explicit approval.", "details": {}, "requestId": "req ..." } } 14.2 主要接口 方法 路径 用途 --- --- --- GET /health API 与数据库健康检查 POST /auth/register 注册 POST /auth/login 登录 POST /auth/logout 退出 GET /auth/me 当前用户 PATCH /auth/me 更新语言偏好 GET/POST /projects 项目列表和创建 GET/PATCH/DELETE /projects/{id} 读取、重命名和归档项目 GET/POST /projects/{id}/messages 读取历史或发送 Agent 消息 GET /projects/{id}/storyboard 获取故事板 PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard 整体替换故事板 POST /projects/{id}/evaluate 故事板即时评估 POST /shots/{id}/estimate 积分估算 POST /shots/{id}/generate 创建生成任务 GET /jobs/{id} 查询任务 GET /providers/pippit 服务端 Pippit 状态 GET /providers/pippit/credits Pippit 积分余额 15. 前端设计 15.1 信息架构 - 公共入口：左侧导航、连续视频背景、居中创作框、灵感快捷项和八项生成设置。 - Agents ：首页创作入口和 VideoAgent 对话。 - Skills ：统一可搜索 Skill 目录，卡片显示 user id/skill id ，用户可发布 Skill。 - Agents ：首页提供产品广告、创作者 Vlog、微短剧、音乐 MV、视频本地化和批量测款六类 Playbook；选择后统一设置提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核模式，再次点击当前项会恢复应用前草稿。 - Skills 目录还覆盖视频本地化、批量变体、剧本助手、智能预演、运镜设计、音乐 MV、参考复刻和外部 Agent 接力。 - Hots ：可搜索社区瀑布流，视频自动播放，展示标题、作者、喜欢数，并支持发布。 - Assets ：通过 Video 与 Skill 两个内部分页切换，支持搜索；Video 卡片悬浮静音播放，Skill 卡片不显示封面；卡片只展示权限和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 - Docs ：按 PRD、Design、Interface、Impl、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO 展示中英文文档，支持全文搜索。 - 项目工作区：对话、Canvas、镜头检查器、生成和审核弹窗。 - 品牌与浏览器标签页图标统一使用蓝色播放键；激活导航图标采用填充/线框反转。 15.2 项目工作区 桌面端采用三栏： Agent 对话 视频预览与故事板 镜头检查器 移动端采用标签页： Agent Canvas Inspector 镜头检查器包含： - Prompt 中英文版本。 - 生成模式。 - 宽高比。 - 时长。 - Provider 模型参数。 - 积分估算。 - 生成与错误提示。 15.3 前端状态 - 页面使用 React useState 、 useEffect 、页面级 fetch 和定时轮询。 - Agent 消息使用普通 JSON 请求；流式输出使用前端分段动画呈现。 - 项目事件使用轮询。 - 不将 Provider 凭据、Access Key 或敏感任务内容写入 localStorage。 16. 国际化策略 产品使用 next-intl 路由、消息资源和后端 locale 字段管理 en 与 zh-CN 。文档提供两套同构内容。 Agent 输出支持三种 Prompt 模式： - 中文说明 + 英文模型 Prompt。 - 全中文。 - 中英双语对照。 后端 API 使用稳定错误码；用户可读文案由前端翻译资源提供。用户语言偏好 仍可通过 PATCH /auth/me 保存。 17. 安全与隐私 - 所有项目、镜头和任务接口均校验用户所有权。 - 会话 Cookie 使用 HttpOnly 与 SameSite=Lax；生产环境必须启用 Secure。 - Pippit CLI 登录文件放在服务账号可访问但受严格权限保护的位置。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只保存在秘密管理系统或服务环境变量中。 - 不使用 Agent 生成的内容拼接 Shell 命令。 - 日志不记录密码、Cookie、Token、Authorization Header。 18. 可靠性设计 - 数据库任务状态为业务事实来源。 - Celery 负责 Provider 轮询，并对未结束任务按配置重试。 - 生成提交使用数据库幂等键；查询失败可以重试，计费提交禁止盲目重发。 - 前端轮询 GET /jobs/{id} ，数据库是状态事实来源。 - Provider 子进程有超时，超时后终止且不自动重提。 19. 可观测性 后端使用 structlog 记录请求与任务日志。核心字段包括 request id 、 user id 、 project id 、 job id 、 provider 、 duration ms 和 error code 。 20. 测试策略 测试以测试驱动开发为主要工作方式。详细测试范围、测试用例、覆盖目标和质量门禁见 docs/software-test-plan.md 。 整体原则： - 每个业务能力先编写失败测试，再实现最小代码，最后重构。 - CI 仅使用 Mock Provider，不执行真实付费生成。 - 单元测试不依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis、MinIO 或 Pippit 网络。 - 集成测试使用可重复、可清理的真实基础设施。 - Pippit 状态和余额只读 Smoke Test 使用受控服务账户。 - 真实生成测试必须人工触发并显式限制次数和积分预算。 22. 配置项 后端使用 VIDEOAGENT 前缀的环境变量： VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL VIDEOAGENT SESSION SECRET VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL 所有敏感值通过环境变量或密钥管理服务提供，不提交到 Git。 22. 部署设计 本地开发： Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite（默认） Pippit CLI 或 Kling MCP Celery + Redis Markdown 文档在构建时生成 HTML，并复制到 public/docs 。 部署流程： 1. 安装锁定依赖。 2. 执行 Ruff、mypy 和测试。 3. 构建前后端镜像。 4. 执行版本化数据库迁移。 5. 滚动更新 API。 6. 更新 Worker。 7. 检查健康和 Provider 状态。 23. 验收标准 1. 用户能够创建、修改、归档和删除自己的项目。 2. Agent 能生成符合 Pydantic Schema 的多镜头故事板。 3. 用户可以在生成前查看并批准预计积分费用。 4. 刷新页面或重启服务后故事板和任务状态不会丢失。 5. Pippit Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 Kling 凭据不出现在浏览器、日志或公开接口中。 6. 生成任务不会因自动重试造成重复扣费。 7. 即时评估返回一致性、覆盖度、清晰度和节奏得分。 8. Hots 的作者、喜欢数、发布入口和预览可用。 9. Mock Provider、Pippit Fake CLI 和 Kling Provider 契约测试全部通过。 24. 主要风险 风险 应对措施 --- --- Pippit CLI 参数或输出变化 命令契约测试、Provider 隔离、版本锁定 生成提交超时导致不确定状态 本地幂等键、任务对账、禁止盲目重试 视频生成耗时长 Celery、持久任务、超时与状态查询 费用误用 审批门、预算上限、积分流水 Token 泄露 服务端加密、日志脱敏、Cookie 安全 前后端类型不一致 OpenAPI 契约测试 Celery 与 LangGraph 状态重复 明确数据库事实来源和单向事件流 中英文内容不同步 统一翻译键、双语测试、Agent Locale 状态

Health GET /health Returns API status and database dependency health. A database failure returns 503 with status: "degraded" . Projects All project endpoints require authentication and are scoped to the current user. Another user's project returns 404 . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /projects List active projects POST /projects Create a project GET /projects/{project id} Read a project PATCH /projects/{project id} Rename a project DELETE /projects/{project id} Archive a project Create request: { "title": "Launch film", "brief": "A ten-second cinematic product launch" } Rename request: { "title": "Launch film — final" } Storyboards Read Storyboard GET /projects/{project id}/storyboard Replace Storyboard PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard { "shots": [ { "description": "Opening product reveal", "prompt en": "Cinematic product reveal with warm rim light", "prompt zh": "暖色轮廓光下的电影感产品亮相", "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "16:9", "generation mode": "text to video" } ] } VideoAgent Conversation List Messages GET /projects/{project id}/messages Send Message POST /projects/{project id}/messages { "content": "Turn the brief into a three-shot launch film" } The response includes the user message, VideoAgent reply, and updated storyboard as JSON. Generation Estimate Cost POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate Generate Shot POST /shots/{shot id}/generate Required header: Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id Request: { "approved": true } Job Status GET /jobs/{job id} Possible statuses include submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , and cancelled . Evaluate Storyboard POST /projects/{project id}/evaluate Returns an immediate review of the current storyboard: { "overall score": 88, "metrics": [ { "key": "consistency", "score": 92 }, { "key": "coverage", "score": 100 }, { "key": "clarity", "score": 84 }, { "key": "pacing", "score": 80 } ], "suggestions": [ { "code": "IMPROVE PROMPTS", "severity": "medium" } ] } Pippit Provider Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /providers/pippit Read server-owned Pippit account status GET /providers/pippit/credits Read the active Pippit credit balance Pippit authorization is server-owned. The API invokes the installed pippit-tool-cli binary; browser clients never receive access keys or CLI session files. Every VideoAgent user therefore uses the same configured Pippit account and credit pool. Operators should authorize the CLI on the API host before enabling live generation. GET /providers/pippit response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "scope": "server" } GET /providers/pippit/credits response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "credits": 42 } If the server CLI is not logged in, the credits endpoint returns connected: false and credits: null . A missing binary returns 503 ; an upstream CLI failure returns 502 . Errors Errors use the following shape: { "error": { "code": "PROJECT NOT FOUND", "message": "The project was not found.", "details": {}, "requestId": "request-id" } } Important status codes: Status Meaning --- --- 401 Authentication required or session expired 403 Explicit approval required 404 Resource not found or not owned by the current user 409 Configured provider is not active 422 Request validation failed 502 Upstream provider request failed 503 Required provider CLI is unavailable

text: VideoAgent Implementation Guide Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.6 Updated 2026-11-04 Design reference software-design.en.md Test reference software-test-plan.en.md 1. Purpose This guide describes the VideoAgent implementation architecture, module boundaries, runtime flow, provider adapters, and engineering conventions. 2. System Scope - Next.js App Router product UI. - Left navigation: Agents, Skills, Hots, Assets, Docs. - Home composer with Skill and Hook selectors, six production playbooks, and transparent custom dropdowns. - Auto-growing prompt textarea with idea suggestions rendered only in the empty state. - Complete live video-model catalogue with provider-labelled Pippit and Kling options. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue using user id/skill id , plus user publishing. - Searchable Hots feed with looping video playback, Skill-backed scenario reuse, and publishing. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs, permission, and yyyy-mm-dd edit date; videos preview on hover, Skill cards have no cover, and cards do not repeat type labels. - Searchable bilingual Docs with eight documents, a collapsible table of contents, and full-text lookup across languages. - Registration, login, logout, server-side sessions, and user isolation. - Project create, list, read, rename, and archive. - Storyboard read and whole-document replacement. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - OpenAI-compatible and deterministic local planners. - Cost estimate and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI, Kling MCP, and Mock Provider adapters. - Celery polling with Redis. - Instant storyboard review. - CI, security scanning, documentation generation, and release builds. 3. Repository Layout VideoAgent/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ │ │ ├── messages/ EN/ZH translation resources │ │ ├── public/docs/ generated English and Chinese Docs │ │ ├── src/app/ Next.js routes and API proxy │ │ ├── src/components/ product UI and project workspace │ │ ├── src/i18n/ next-intl routing │ │ └── tests/ ├── packages/landing/ │ ├── src/index.tsx shared product UI │ ├── src/content.ts English and Chinese content │ └── src/landing.css shared visual system ├── services/api/src/videoagent/ │ ├── agent/ graph and planner │ ├── api/ FastAPI routes │ ├── providers/ Pippit, Kling MCP, Mock │ ├── services/ storyboard, jobs, evaluation │ └── workers/ ├── docs/ paired Markdown sources ├── scripts/build pages.py Markdown and static Docs builder └── .github/workflows/ 4. Runtime Browser ├── Next.js :3000 │ ├── /api/account/ → FastAPI :8000/api/v1 │ └── /docs/ → generated HTML FastAPI ├── SQLite by default ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling MCP Celery Worker ├── Redis broker └── Pippit query-result The browser account and home creation requests use the Next.js Route Handler. The project workspace uses NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL . 5. Request Flows 5.1 Authentication register/login → normalize email → hash password with Argon2 → create opaque session token → store SHA-256 token hash → set HttpOnly SameSite cookie 5.2 Storyboards PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard replaces the complete shot list, increments Storyboard.version , and assigns contiguous shot indexes starting at zero. 5.3 Agent POST /projects/{project id}/messages → persist user message → execute LangGraph plan storyboard → validate StoryboardPlan → replace storyboard → persist assistant message → return both messages and current storyboard 5.4 Generation estimate → POST /shots/{id}/estimate generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → provider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → enqueue Celery polling status → GET /jobs/{id} → refresh from Provider when non-terminal 6. Backend Modules Module Responsibility --- --- main.py FastAPI app, lifespan, routers, errors config.py VIDEOAGENT settings models.py SQLAlchemy ORM models schemas.py API and Agent schemas api.auth Account and session flows api.projects Project lifecycle and ownership api.storyboards Storyboard read/replace api.agent Message history and planning api.generation Estimate, submit, job status api.evaluation Storyboard review api.providers Pippit status and credits providers.pippit CLI process and JSON adaptation providers.kling Kling MCP tool adapter and task mapping providers.mock Deterministic local generation agent.graph One-node LangGraph agent.planner Local/OpenAI-compatible planners 7. Frontend Modules Module Responsibility --- --- packages/landing/src/index.tsx Shared nav, composer, Skills, Hots, Docs packages/landing/src/content.ts English UI and Chinese resources app-landing-page.tsx Product home project creation project-workspace.tsx Conversation, canvas, inspector, generation, review projects-dashboard.tsx Project list, rename, archive scripts/build pages.py bilingual Docs build 8. Skills Implementation Skills is one flat searchable catalogue. Cards show user id/skill id and preload actionable prompts into the Agents composer: video agent/search all resources video agent/text to video video agent/image to video video agent/reference to video video agent/first last frame video agent/motion control video agent/video extend video agent/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same card form as other task-oriented Skills. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own namespace. Production playbooks are defined in packages/landing/src/content.ts with a prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. Applying one updates the full composer draft; clicking the active playbook again restores the saved pre-playbook composer state. Hots cards carry a Skill ID so scenario reuse enters Agents with the matching Skill selected. 9. Documentation Localization The globe control switches documentation language. English: product-requirements.html Chinese: product-requirements.zh.html The same pattern applies to all eight documents in this order: PRD, Design, Interface, Impl, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. Docs search uses docs-search.json across both languages. Docs language follows application locale state. 10. Data Model Table Purpose --- --- users User, password hash, locale sessions Token hashes and expiry projects Owner, title, brief, state storyboards Current board and version shots Prompt, frame, duration, status conversations One per project messages User/assistant content generation jobs Provider task and idempotency provider connections Legacy OAuth storage oauth flows Legacy OAuth state 11. API List Method Path --- --- GET /health POST /auth/register POST /auth/login POST /auth/logout GET/PATCH /auth/me GET/POST /projects GET/PATCH/DELETE /projects/{id} GET/POST /projects/{id}/messages GET/PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard POST /projects/{id}/evaluate POST /shots/{id}/estimate POST /shots/{id}/generate GET /jobs/{id} GET /providers/pippit GET /providers/pippit/credits 12. Security - Argon2 password hashing. - Opaque session tokens with SHA-256 storage. - HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax cookies. - Ownership checks on projects, shots, and jobs. - Pippit credentials remain server-side. - Kling OAuth state remains inside the MCP connector boundary. - CLI calls use argument arrays and timeouts. - Secret and dependency scanning run in CI. 13. Next.js App Router Web 界面。 - 左侧 Agents、Skills、Hots、Assets、Docs 导航和独立视图切换。 - 蓝色播放键品牌、无框标签页图标和激活图标填充/线框反转。 - 首页连续视频轮播、流式主标语、Skill/Hook 选择器、场景 Playbook、自定义透明下拉和 Action 生成入口。 - 创作输入框根据 scrollHeight 自动增高，并在输入非空时隐藏示例灵感；Playbook 保持可用，重复点击当前项会恢复应用前草稿。 - 模型下拉框使用统一模型元数据，展示 Pippit 8 个、Kling 7 个当前可用的视频模型及 Provider。 - Skills 使用单一可搜索目录，显示 user id/skill id ，支持发布 Skill。 - Hots 支持搜索、循环视频、作者、喜欢数、发布，以及带 Skill 的场景复用。 - Assets 使用瀑布流，并通过 Video/Skill 内部分页区分类型；Video 卡片悬浮静音播放，Skill 卡片无封面并展示 private/public 和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 - 八份中英文文档、全文搜索、统一深色阅读主题、左侧可折叠目录和章节高亮。 - 注册、登录、登出和服务端会话。 - 用户级项目创建、列表、读取、重命名和归档。 - 用户数据所有权隔离。 - 多镜头故事板创建、读取和版本化替换。 - LangGraph 单节点 Agent 编排。 - 无模型密钥时的确定性本地故事板规划器。 - 配置 OpenAI-compatible 模型后的结构化故事板规划器。 - 积分估算和显式生成审批。 - 生成任务持久化及 Idempotency-Key 防重复提交。 - Mock Provider。 - Pippit CLI 视频提交、任务查询和余额读取。 - Kling MCP 文本生成视频、图生视频、动作控制和多模态参考。 - 任务状态 API 刷新。 - Celery 后台轮询。 - 故事板即时评估与前端审核弹窗。 - Docker Compose 基础设施配置。 - GitHub Actions CI 配置。 - Markdown 文档构建。 3. 仓库结构 VideoAgent/ ├── apps/web/ │ ├── messages/ en.json、zh-CN.json │ ├── src/app/[locale]/ 国际化页面 │ ├── src/components/ Auth、项目、工作区等组件 │ ├── src/i18n/ 路由、导航和请求配置 │ ├── src/lib/ 前端工具函数 │ └── tests/ Vitest 测试 ├── packages/landing/ │ ├── src/index.tsx 共享首页、导航、Hots、Docs │ ├── src/content.ts 英文内容与中文占位资源 │ └── src/landing.css 共享视觉样式 ├── services/api/ │ ├── src/videoagent/ │ │ ├── agent/ LangGraph 和 Planner │ │ ├── api/ FastAPI 路由与依赖 │ │ ├── providers/ Mock、Pippit CLI、Kling MCP │ │ ├── services/ 业务服务 │ │ ├── workers/ Celery 配置和任务 │ │ ├── config.py │ │ ├── db.py │ │ ├── models.py │ │ ├── schemas.py │ │ └── main.py │ └── tests/ ├── deploy/docker-compose.yml ├── scripts/ 启动、检查、文档构建 ├── docs/ ├── .github/workflows/ CI、Pages、安全扫描 ├── package.json └── pnpm-workspace.yaml 4. 运行时架构 Browser │ ├── Next.js :3000 │ ├── Route Handler /api/account/ → FastAPI :8000/api/v1 │ └── public/docs/ → 内嵌文档 │ └── FastAPI ├── SQLite ├── PostgreSQL ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling MCP Celery Worker ├── Redis Broker ├── PostgreSQL/SQLite └── Provider task query 当前本地开发中，浏览器直接访问 FastAPI 的 8000 端口。FastAPI 已配置本地 CORS。 正式产品首页通过 Next.js Route Handler 代理账户与项目请求；项目工作区仍按 NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL 访问 FastAPI。 生产环境规划通过反向代理保持同域： https://example.com/ → Next.js https://example.com/api/ → FastAPI 5. 请求流程 5.1 注册与会话 浏览器提交注册信息 → FastAPI 规范化邮箱 → Argon2 哈希密码 → 创建 User → 生成随机不透明 Session Token → 数据库只保存 Token 的 SHA-256 → HttpOnly Cookie 返回浏览器 受保护接口从 Cookie 读取会话 Token，通过哈希查找有效 Session，再加载 User。 5.2 项目与故事板 创建项目 → 校验当前 Session → 写入 owner id 读取或修改项目资源 → 同时校验 resource id 和 owner id → 其他用户统一得到 404 故事板使用 PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard 整体替换镜头列表。替换时： 1. 删除旧 Shot。 2. Storyboard.version 加一。 3. 根据请求顺序重建 Shot。 4. index 从 0 开始连续分配。 5.3 Agent 对话 POST /projects/{project id}/messages → 保存 user Message → LangGraph 调用 StoryboardPlanner → 输出 StoryboardPlan → 保存或替换 Storyboard → 保存 assistant Message → 返回两条 Message 和最新 Storyboard Agent 图只有一个节点： START → plan storyboard → END 5.4 生成任务 用户点击估算 → POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate → Provider 返回 CostEstimate 用户批准生成 → POST /shots/{shot id}/generate → 校验 Idempotency-Key → 调用 Provider.submit → 保存 GenerationJob → 更新 Shot 状态 → 投递 Celery 轮询任务 如果相同镜头和 Idempotency-Key 已经存在，接口返回已有 Job，HTTP 状态为 200，不会再次提交 Provider。 前端每 5 秒请求一次任务状态。 GET /jobs/{job id} 会在任务未结束时调用 Provider 查询最新状态。 5.5 Celery 轮询 启用 VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED=true 后： 生成接口提交 Job → videoagent.poll generation job.delay(job id) → Worker 加载 Job → 使用服务端 Pippit CLI 配置 → 调用 query-result → 更新 Job 和 Shot → 未结束则指数退避重试 Worker 对已结束的 Job 直接返回，保证重复投递不会继续调用 Provider。 6. 后端模块职责 模块 职责 --- --- main.py FastAPI 应用工厂、生命周期、路由和异常处理器 config.py 环境变量配置 db.py Async SQLAlchemy api/storyboards.py 故事板读取和替换 api/agent.py 对话和消息持久化 api/generation.py 积分估算、生成提交和任务查询 api/evaluation.py 项目故事板即时评估 api/providers.py Pippit 服务端状态和积分余额 services/storyboards.py 故事板领域操作 services/generation agent/planner.py 本地和远程故事板规划器 workers/celery app.py Celery 配置 workers/tasks.py 异步轮询任务 7. 前端模块职责 模块 职责 --- --- app/[locale]/page.tsx 加载共享首页与正式产品客户端适配层 components/app-landing-page.tsx 首页创作框提交、项目创建和路由跳转 Docs locale-switcher.tsx 中英文切换 auth-form.tsx 注册/登录请求 projects-dashboard.tsx 项目列表、新建、重命名和删除 project-workspace.tsx 自动开始首轮 Agent 对话、故事板、镜头设置和生成 scripts/build pages.py 生成文档 HTML、目录与静态资源 前端通过 NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL 访问 FastAPI，所有鉴权请求设置 credentials: "include" 。 前端请求类型以 FastAPI OpenAPI 契约为准。 8. 国际化实现 保留的语言资源： en zh-CN 核心文件： - src/i18n/config.ts ：语言列表和显示名称。 - src/i18n/routing.ts ：next-intl 路由。 - src/i18n/navigation.ts ：本地化 Link 和 Router。 - src/i18n/request.ts ：加载消息文件。 - src/proxy.ts ：语言前缀路由。 - messages/en.json 、 messages/zh-CN.json ：翻译资源。 开发规则： - 两种语言的 Key 保持一致。 - 后端返回稳定错误码，不在数据库保存前端展示文案。 - 新增内部翻译 Key 时同时维护中英文资源。 - Docs 语言直接跟随当前应用语言状态，不使用独立的文档语言缓存。 - Agent 输出语言来自 User.locale 。 - 视频模型 Prompt 使用 prompt en ，中文解释保存在 prompt zh 。 9. 数据模型 ORM 表： 表 主要用途 --- --- users 用户、密码哈希和语言偏好 sessions 服务端会话 Token 哈希 projects 项目和所有者 storyboards 每个项目唯一的当前故事板 shots 镜头 Prompt、比例、时长和状态 conversations 每个项目唯一的对话 messages User/Assistant 消息 generation jobs Provider 任务、幂等键和结果 provider connections Provider 授权信息 oauth flows OAuth 事务状态 关键约束： - 业务主键使用 UUID。 - Project.owner id 决定资源权限。 - Storyboard.project id 唯一。 - Conversation.project id 唯一。 - (Shot.storyboard id, Shot.index) 唯一。 - (GenerationJob.shot id, GenerationJob.idempotency key) 唯一。 - (ProviderConnection.user id, ProviderConnection.provider) 唯一。 - OAuthFlow.state hash 具有唯一约束。 10. Pippit CLI Provider 10.1 Provider 选择 VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER 支持： 值 行为 --- --- pippit 使用服务端安装并授权的 Pippit CLI auto 当前兼容别名，与 pippit 行为相同 mock 使用本地 Mock，不执行 CLI 或外部生成 默认值为 pippit 。测试环境显式使用 mock 。 10.2 服务端授权 安装 @pippit-dev/cli → pippit-tool-cli login → 浏览器完成 Pippit 授权 → CLI 写入操作系统安全存储 → FastAPI 子进程复用服务端登录状态 CI 可改用 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY ，Provider 只把该值转换为子进程 环境变量 XYQ ACCESS KEY 。它不是用户级凭据，不写入数据库，也不通过 API 返回。 10.3 CLI 调用 PippitVideoProvider 使用参数数组启动子进程，不拼接 Shell 字符串： status → logged in get-credit-balance → total remain amount generate-video → thread id + run id query-result → completed + videos[].download url Provider 将 CLI 输出转换为稳定领域对象： GenerationRequest → generate-video → JSON task reference → ProviderJob task reference → query-result → JobStatus + result URL 子进程标准输出必须是单个 JSON 对象；标准错误和完整参数不返回浏览器。 退出码非 0、无效 JSON、超时和缺少必要 ID 均映射为 Provider 错误。 11. API 清单 基础路径： /api/v1 方法 路径 说明 --- --- --- GET /health API 与数据库健康状态 POST /auth/register 注册并创建 Session POST /auth/login 登录并创建 Session POST /auth/logout 删除当前 Session GET /auth/me 当前用户 PATCH /auth/me 更新语言偏好 GET /projects 当前用户项目列表 POST /projects 创建项目 GET /projects/{id} 读取项目 PATCH /projects/{id} 重命名项目 DELETE /projects/{id} 归档项目 GET /projects/{id}/messages 对话历史 POST /projects/{id}/messages Agent 生成故事板并保存对话 GET /projects/{id}/storyboard 获取故事板 PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard 整体替换故事板 POST /shots/{id}/estimate 查询积分估算 POST /shots/{id}/generate 提交生成任务 GET /jobs/{id} 查询并刷新任务状态 POST /projects/{id}/evaluate 即时评估当前故事板 GET /providers/pippit 服务端 Pippit 登录状态 GET /providers/pippit/credits Pippit 积分余额 生成接口必须携带： Idempotency-Key: <unique-client-generated-key 错误响应： { "error": { "code": "PROJECT NOT FOUND", "message": "The project was not found.", "details": {}, "requestId": "..." } } 12. 安全实现 - 密码使用 Argon2。 - 会话使用随机不透明 Token，数据库只保存 SHA-256。 - 会话 Cookie 为 HttpOnly 和 SameSite=Lax。 - Pippit CLI 登录文件放在服务账号可访问但权限受限的位置。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只来自秘密环境变量。 - CLI 子进程有超时，命令参数不经 Shell 解释。 - 跨用户资源访问统一返回 404。 - 日志和 API 响应不返回 Provider Token。 - 敏感环境变量不得提交到 Git。 13. 本地开发 13.1 启动 API cd D:\ Science\Agent\VideoAgent .\scripts\dev-api.ps1 启动脚本会将 Windows PowerShell、Python 标准输出和代码页切换为 UTF-8，避免中文日志乱码。 默认数据库： services/api/.data/videoagent.db 13.2 启动 Web cd D:\ Science\Agent\VideoAgent .\scripts\dev-web.ps1 该脚本同样会统一控制台编码，并启动 Next.js 开发服务。 访问： http://localhost:3000/en http://localhost:8000/docs 13.3 启动 Celery 先启动 Redis，然后： .\scripts\dev-worker.ps1 同时必须让 API 和 Worker 使用相同的： VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY 13.4 Docker 基础设施 docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d 启动 PostgreSQL、Redis 和 MinIO。 14. 配置项 变量 默认值 说明 --- --- --- VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL SQLite .data/videoagent.db SQLAlchemy Async URL VIDEOAGENT COOKIE SECURE false HTTPS 环境应设为 true VIDEOAGENT SESSION SECRET 开发值 必须替换 VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY 开发值 必须替换 VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER pippit pippit/auto/mock VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND pippit-tool-cli CLI 命令或可执行路径 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 空 CI 可选服务端 Access Key VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL 空 留空使用 CLI 服务默认模型 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION 空 例如 720p VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT TIMEOUT SECONDS 180 子进程超时 VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED false 是否投递轮询任务 VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL Redis localhost Celery Broker VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND Redis localhost Celery Result VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL 空 OpenAI-compatible Endpoint VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY 空 模型密钥 VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL 空 模型名称 NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL http://localhost:8000/api/v1 浏览器 API 地址 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只适用于服务端或 CI。本地和生产主机优先使用 pippit-tool-cli login ，避免把长期凭据写入 .env 。 15. 测试与质量门禁 后端： cd services\api uv run pytest uv run ruff format --check src tests uv run ruff check src tests uv run mypy src 前端： pnpm --dir apps/web test pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm --dir apps/web build 测试组成： - 后端 35 个测试。 - 前端 24 个测试。 - 后端测试使用临时 SQLite 文件。 - Pippit 测试使用本地 Fake CLI，不访问真实生成网络。 - Kling Provider 测试使用 Fake MCP client，不触发付费生成。 - 前端测试覆盖共享首页、导航、文档加载、自定义下拉、Hots 发布、创作提交和轮播行为。 - 普通 CI 不执行付费生成。 新增功能必须遵循： 1. 先编写失败测试。 2. 实现最小代码。 3. 重构。 4. 运行相关测试和全部质量门禁。 16. 开发规范 16.1 后端 - 路由层只处理 HTTP 转换和依赖注入。 - 领域逻辑放在 services/ 。 - Provider 细节只放在 providers/ 。 - 所有外部输入由 Pydantic 校验。 - API 错误使用稳定错误码。 - 不能把 Pippit Access Key 或 CLI 登录文件写入日志。 - 新查询必须包含用户所有权条件。 16.2 Agent - LLM 输出必须使用 Pydantic 结构化模型。 - 不在 Agent 中直接执行删除、支付或账号操作。 - 外部生成操作必须经过明确的计费审批。 - Prompt 中上传内容和用户文本均视为不可信。 - 本地规划器必须保持可用，确保无模型环境可以开发。 16.3 Provider - 所有 Provider 实现 VideoProvider 接口。 - Provider 错误必须转换为稳定的业务错误。 - 生成提交禁止无幂等保护地重试。 - 查询失败可以退避重试。 - 原始响应与标准化响应分开保存。 16.4 前端 - 服务端状态使用 TanStack Query 或页面级异步加载。 - 临时交互状态使用 React state/Zustand。 - 新文案必须同时进入 en.json 和 zh-CN.json 。 - 优先使用语义标签和可访问控件。 - 动效必须支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - Pippit 凭据不得进入 localStorage 或浏览器状态。 17. 扩展点 新增视频 Provider 1. 实现 VideoProvider 。 2. 将 Provider 错误映射为领域错误。 3. 增加 Provider Contract 测试。 4. 在 Provider Resolver 中增加选择逻辑。 5. 增加前端能力展示和积分字段。 新增 Agent 节点 1. 在 AgentState 中增加类型化状态。 2. 为该状态迁移编写单元测试。 3. 将节点加入 StateGraph 。 4. 保持节点幂等。 5. 涉及外部长任务时交给 Celery，不在图节点内阻塞等待。 新增 API 1. 在 schemas.py 增加输入输出模型。 2. 在 services/ 增加业务逻辑。 3. 在 api/ 增加薄路由。 4. 增加所有权和未授权测试。 5. 更新本文档和 OpenAPI 调用方。 19. 提交流程检查清单 - 功能有对应失败测试和通过测试。 - 新接口包含鉴权与资源所有权校验。 - 新文案中英文 Key 一致。 - 没有提交 .env 、Token、上传媒体或本地数据库。 - Ruff、mypy、pytest、TypeScript、Vitest 和 Next Build 通过。 - 新增外部依赖已写入锁文件。 - 新增配置已写入 .env.example 。 - 设计或实现边界变化已更新本文档。

text: VideoAgent Testing and TDD Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.0 Updated 2026-11-04 Frameworks pytest, Vitest, Testing Library Related design software-design.en.md 1. Purpose This document defines the automated test strategy, contracts, quality gates, and acceptance checks for the VideoAgent system. 2. TDD Rules 1. Add one failing behavior test. 2. Implement the smallest change that passes. 3. Refactor without changing public behavior. 4. Run all relevant quality gates before commit. Tests assert public behavior, API contracts, ownership, state transitions, and user-visible outcomes rather than private implementation details. 3. Test Layers Unit and component tests → Provider and API contract tests → SQLite integration tests → browser component tests External paid generation is never part of normal CI. 4. Coverage Backend: - Password hashing and session behavior. - Project ownership, rename, and archive. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Agent planning with deterministic and fake LLM behavior. - Mock, Pippit, and Kling Provider contracts. - Estimate, approval, idempotency, and job status. - Provider status and credits. - Health endpoint. - Instant storyboard evaluation. Frontend: - Shared landing structure and navigation. - Sequenced and looping hero headline. - Search composer and custom settings dropdowns. - Project creation flow. - Assets, Hots, and Docs view switching. - Assets permission, date, hover preview, and cover behavior. - Hots author, likes, playback, and publishing. - English-to-Chinese Docs switching. - Project list, authentication form, and project workspace. 5. Provider Contract Tests Every VideoProvider verifies: - Provider name is stable. - Estimate returns normalized credits and duration. - Submit returns a stable task reference. - Status maps to pending , submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , or cancelled . - Errors do not expose credentials or full sensitive command arguments. - The same idempotency key does not submit twice. Pippit tests use a local fake CLI and cover status, credits, submit, query, timeout, missing binary, invalid JSON, and missing task IDs. Kling tests use a fake MCP client and cover text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, task-state mapping, and result extraction. 6. API Tests Required assertions: - Authentication and ownership. - Response status and schema. - Stable error codes. - Explicit generation approval. - Idempotency behavior. - Storyboard replacement ordering. - Agent message persistence. - Evaluation result shape. - No provider credentials in responses. 7. Frontend Tests Component tests cover: - Left navigation with isolated views. - Custom dropdown rendering and selection. - Action button enabled and disabled states. - Hots metadata order: title above author and likes. - Every Hots card contains an autoplaying muted looping video. - Publish entry uses the blue play icon. - Skills is one searchable catalogue with user id/skill id labels. - Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review settings. - Re-clicking the active playbook restores the prior composer state. - Hots scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill and prompt. - The textarea grows with multiline content, and idea suggestions disappear while the prompt contains non-whitespace text. - The Model selector includes every available Kling and Pippit video model. - Docs labels are PRD , Design , Interface , Impl , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . - Globe control changes Docs source and language. - Skills, Hots, Assets, and Docs search controls stay pinned while content scrolls. - Assets switches between Video and Skill tabs without repeating type labels. - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Composer menus stay inside the viewport. - Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. - Avatar opens login and registration when signed out and sign-out when signed in. - Interface starts with its metadata table. - FAQ and TODO have paired English and Chinese documents. 8. Responsive and Accessibility Checks - Keyboard access for navigation, dropdowns, Docs, and dialogs. - Visible focus states. - Sufficient text size and contrast. - Reduced-motion support. - Desktop sidebar and mobile navigation remain usable. - Long English and Chinese text do not overlap. 9. CI Gates Pull requests must pass: Ruff check and formatting mypy strict checks pytest Vitest TypeScript check Next.js production build Docs and static artifact build secret and dependency scans 10. Provider Verification Read-only 1. Install and authenticate pippit-tool-cli . 2. Run status and get-credit-balance . 3. Query /providers/pippit and /providers/pippit/credits . 4. Verify logs omit access keys. 5. Verify Kling MCP who am i confirms authorization and model discovery. Authorized paid generation Only with explicit user approval and budget: 1. Record starting credits. 2. Submit one minimal task. 3. Verify the idempotency key and Provider task reference. 4. Poll to completion. 5. Record result, credits, and UI/API consistency. 6. Do not automatically retry an uncertain submission. 11. Definition of Done - Tests were written before implementation or alongside a documented regression case. - Relevant local tests pass. - Ruff, mypy, TypeScript, Next build, and Docs build pass. - No secrets, local databases, or generated media are committed. - API and UI documentation are updated when behavior changes. - Paid Provider tests remain opt-in.

text: VideoAgent 软件测试与 TDD 规范 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v2.0 更新日期 2026-11-04 测试框架 pytest、Vitest、Testing Library 关联设计 docs/software-design.md 1. 目的 本文档定义 VideoAgent 的自动化测试策略、契约、质量门禁与验收检查。 2. TDD 规则 1. 先编写一个失败的行为测试。 2. 编写足以通过测试的最小实现。 3. 在不改变公开行为的前提下重构。 4. 提交前执行完整质量门禁。 测试关注公开行为、API 契约、权限、状态迁移和用户可见结果，不绑定私有实现细节。 3. 测试分层 单元与组件测试 → Provider 与 API 契约测试 → SQLite 集成测试 → 浏览器组件测试 真实付费生成不进入普通 CI。 4. 覆盖范围 后端： - 密码哈希与会话行为。 - 项目所有权、重命名和归档。 - 故事板替换与版本。 - 确定性 Planner 与 Fake LLM 的 Agent 规划。 - Mock、Pippit 和 Kling Provider 契约。 - 积分估算、审批、幂等和任务状态。 - Provider 状态与积分。 - 健康检查。 - 故事板即时评估。 前端： - 共享 Landing 结构与导航。 - 流式主标题和视频轮播。 - 创作框与自定义下拉。 - 项目创建流程。 - Assets、Hots 和 Docs 视图切换。 - Assets 权限、日期、悬浮预览与封面行为。 - Hots 作者、喜欢数、播放和发布。 - Docs 中英文切换。 - 项目列表、认证表单与项目工作区。 5. Provider 契约测试 每个 VideoProvider 验证： - Provider 名称稳定。 - 积分估算返回标准化积分与时长。 - 提交返回稳定任务引用。 - 状态映射为 pending 、 submitted 、 queued 、 running 、 succeeded 、 failed 或 cancelled 。 - 错误不暴露凭据或完整敏感命令参数。 - 相同幂等键不会重复提交。 Pippit 测试使用本地 Fake CLI，覆盖状态、积分、提交、查询、超时、缺失二进制、 无效 JSON 和缺失任务 ID。Kling 测试使用 Fake MCP Client，覆盖文生视频、 图生视频、动作控制、任务状态映射和结果提取。 6. API 测试 必须验证： - 认证与所有权。 - 响应状态码和 Schema。 - 稳定错误码。 - 显式生成审批。 - 幂等行为。 - 故事板替换后的镜头顺序。 - Agent 消息持久化。 - 评估结果结构。 - 响应不包含 Provider 凭据。 7. 前端测试 组件测试覆盖： - 左侧独立视图导航。 - 自定义下拉渲染与选择。 - Action 启用和禁用状态。 - Hots 元数据顺序：标题在作者与喜欢数之上。 - 每张 Hots 卡片包含自动播放、静音、循环视频。 - 发布入口使用蓝色播放键。 - Skills 使用 user id/skill id 的单一搜索目录。 - Playbook 正确填充提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核设置。 - 再次点击当前 Playbook 会恢复应用前状态。 - Hots 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill 和提示词。 - 输入框随多行内容增高，输入非空时隐藏示例灵感。 - Model 目录包含全部 Kling 与 Pippit 视频模型。 - Docs 标签为 PRD 、 Design 、 Interface 、 Impl 、 Test 、 Ops 、 FAQ 、 TODO 。 - Globe 控件切换 Docs 语言。 - Skills、Hots、Assets、Docs 搜索框保持固定。 - Assets 通过 Video/Skill 分页切换，不重复类型标签。 - Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片无封面。 - 创作框菜单不超出视口。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面。 - 头像在未登录时提供登录与注册，登录后提供退出。 - Interface 开头展示属性表。 - FAQ 与 TODO 均有中英文版本。 8. 响应式与可访问性 - 导航、下拉、Docs 和弹窗可用键盘操作。 - 焦点样式清晰。 - 字号和对比度充足。 - 支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 桌面侧栏和移动导航可用。 - 中英文长文本不重叠。 9. CI 门禁 Pull Request 必须通过： Ruff 检查与格式检查 mypy 严格类型检查 pytest Vitest TypeScript 检查 Next.js 生产构建 Docs 与静态产物构建 敏感信息和依赖扫描 10. Provider 验证 只读检查 1. 安装并认证 pippit-tool-cli 。 2. 执行 status 与 get-credit-balance 。 3. 查询 /providers/pippit 和 /providers/pippit/credits 。 4. 验证日志不包含 Access Key。 5. 使用 Kling MCP who am i 验证授权与模型发现。 获准的付费生成 仅在用户明确批准预算时： 1. 记录起始积分。 2. 提交一个最小任务。 3. 验证幂等键和 Provider Task Reference。 4. 轮询到完成。 5. 记录结果、积分和 UI/API 状态一致性。 6. 不确定提交禁止自动重试。 11. 完成定义 - 测试先于实现，或与已记录的回归用例同步编写。 - 相关本地测试通过。 - Ruff、mypy、TypeScript、Next Build 和 Docs Build 通过。 - 不提交密钥、本地数据库或生成媒体。 - 行为变化同步更新 API 与 UI 文档。 - 付费 Provider 测试保持人工开启。

text: VideoAgent Operations Strategy Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.0 Updated 2026-11-04 Scope Skills, Hots, Assets, providers, support, metrics 1. Operating Model VideoAgent operates three content layers: 1. Official Skills under the video agent namespace. 2. User-published Skills and Hots entries. 3. Project outputs stored in Assets. 2. Release Readiness - Complete authentication and credit-usage acceptance. - Verify Pippit CLI authorization and Kling MCP OAuth. - Publish PRD, Design, Interface, Impl, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. - Verify English and Chinese Docs switching. - Verify project creation, storyboard planning, generation approval, and job polling with the configured provider. - Confirm provider credentials never appear in browser bundles, logs, or API responses. 3. Official Skill Operations - Official user namespace: video agent . - Skill IDs are stable, lowercase, and underscore-separated. - Every Skill states its input, output, provider dependency, and credit impact. - Skill changes update PRD, Design, and Test. - Deprecated Skills remain listed for one release with a migration note. - Scenario playbooks reference current Skills and stay aligned with composer fields. - External Agent handoff uses an explicit MCP or CLI contract. 4. Asset Operations - Assets contains only the current user's work. - Public and private permissions are explicit. - Edit dates use yyyy-mm-dd . - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Video and Skill use internal tabs rather than repeated type labels. 5. Provider and Cost Operations - Pippit CLI and Kling MCP are available through the provider boundary. - Billable generation requires explicit user approval. - Provider submission uses database idempotency keys. - Credits and provider status are read server-side. - Monitor provider errors, timeout rate, uncertain submissions, and duplicate protection. - Preserve provider task references for reconciliation. 6. Release Procedure 1. Run backend tests, frontend tests, type checks, builds, and Docs generation. 2. Check secret scanning and dependency security results. 3. Confirm provider status and credit balance without spending credits. 4. Validate English and Chinese Docs, search, navigation, and responsive layout. 5. Record the release commit. 7. Monitoring - Registration and login success rate. - Project creation success rate. - Storyboard generation success and latency. - Generation approval-to-submit conversion. - Provider success, failure, timeout, and uncertain-submit rate. - Duplicate generation prevented by idempotency. - Credit consumption per project. - Docs search usage and broken document links. 8. Support Support triage order: 1. Authentication and session failures. 2. Provider unavailable or authorization failures. 3. Credit and billing anomalies. 4. Job state or duplicate submission concerns. 5. Search, Docs, and navigation defects. 6. Visual and copy issues. Support never asks users for access keys, cookies, or CLI session files. 9. Incident Response - Disable billable generation before retrying an uncertain provider incident. - Preserve job records and provider task references. - Roll back the web release independently from provider credentials. - Publish a status note with affected areas and mitigation. - Review billing, duplicate jobs, cross-user access, and audit evidence. 10. text: VideoAgent Agent Engineering Interview FAQ Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.0 Updated 2026-11-04 Target roles Video Agent engineering roles such as ByteDance Xiaoyunque and Kuaishou Kling Answer rule State the fact, explain the trade-off, then describe the evolution This FAQ is written from an interviewer's perspective. Answers emphasize system boundaries, engineering trade-offs, and verifiability without presenting hypothetical designs as shipped facts. Q1. How would you orchestrate a video Agent? Follow-up: Why not start with a multi-Agent system? Strong answer: Start with a deterministic workflow, not an unbounded ReAct loop. The main path should cover brief, creative diagnosis, treatment, script/beats, storyboard, continuity validation, previz, generation, shot QC, rough cut, and delivery, with human gates for story, budget, and final direction. A single planner is appropriate while responsibilities share one context. Split into specialized Agents only when writing, visual planning, production, and review need genuinely different tools and context. Extended topics: LangGraph StateGraph, conditional edges, checkpoints, human-in-the-loop, tool allowlists, structured output, recoverable state. Q2. The user says, “Change shot 3 only.” How do you implement that? Follow-up: Should a review-only request replace the storyboard? Strong answer: Route intent first: create, revise, review only, regenerate a take, or localize. A local revision should return a shot patch, not a full storyboard. Stable shot IDs, versions, and operation logs let only affected nodes change while untouched shots remain intact. Extended topics: function calling, JSON Patch, idempotent updates, concurrent versions, event sourcing, optimistic locking. Q3. What fields define a production-ready shot? Follow-up: Why are prompt, duration, and aspect ratio insufficient? Strong answer: A prompt is a generation parameter, not a directing plan. A shot also needs scene/beat, story function, shot size, angle, lens, movement, subject action, gaze, blocking, lighting, palette, sound, transition, continuity references, and entry/exit state. A prompt and duration alone cannot guarantee narrative, spatial, gaze, and continuity constraints. Extended topics: master/medium/close/insert/reaction, 180-degree rule, 30-degree rule, eyeline match, screen direction, match cut, motivated camera movement. Q4. How do you make LLM output executable rather than merely plausible? Follow-up: What happens after the model returns JSON? Strong answer: Validate it with Pydantic, including required fields, duration, aspect ratio, shot count, and references. Use a bounded repair loop, then return a structured error. Before execution, negotiate provider capability such as supported duration, audio, first/last frame, or reference inputs. The model makes creative decisions; code enforces permissions, budget, and hard production constraints. Extended topics: schema validation, retry budget, repair loop, capability negotiation, deterministic fallback, tool permissions. Q5. When should a video Agent use MCP versus a CLI? Follow-up: Are the two integrations redundant? Strong answer: Choose by runtime boundary, not protocol preference. A CLI fits stable server-side jobs and batch operations. MCP fits exposing capabilities to personal or cross-Agent workflows. Both should sit behind one Provider contract that normalizes submit, query, cancel, errors, and result URLs. Pippit is integrated through a server-side CLI and Kling through MCP tools; both share one task contract. Extended topics: adapters, capability discovery, OAuth, credential isolation, timeout, uncertain submission, provider fallback. Q6. What do you do when a generation request times out? Follow-up: Can you simply retry three times? Strong answer: Never blindly retry a billable submission. Write the idempotency key and job record first. On timeout enter submission uncertain , query the provider, and stop automatic submission if reconciliation is impossible. Read-only status queries can use bounded backoff, but billable submission requires idempotency and an explainable recovery path. Extended topics: at-least-once delivery, idempotency, outbox, Celery, dead-letter queue, reconciliation, state machines, SSE reconnect. Q7. How should a video Agent be evaluated? Follow-up: Are the current consistency, coverage, clarity, and pacing scores enough? Strong answer: They are useful low-cost baselines, but counting at least three shots is not real story coverage. Evaluate by stage: script for desire, conflict, turn, and ending; boards for coverage, continuity, eyeline, and feasibility; shots for identity, prompt alignment, and defects; the cut for rhythm, sound, and retention. Combine deterministic rules, VLM review, and human preference data. Extended topics: rubrics, LLM-as-a-judge, VLM, pairwise preference, inter-rater agreement, gaming resistance, offline/online evaluation, guardrails. Q8. How do you preserve character and scene consistency across shots? Follow-up: Is repeating one description in every prompt sufficient? Strong answer: No. Use a style bible, reusable character/scene/prop references, shot-level continuity references, and checks for screen direction, eyeline, wardrobe, time, and spatial relationships. Run VLM checks after generation and regenerate only affected shots. Kling Element and Omni-Ref can provide subject references, but they should be adapted behind the same capability contract. Extended topics: subject references, identity drift, motion continuity, reference hierarchy, negative constraints, dependency graphs. Q9. How do you control credits and user expectations? Follow-up: Is a confirmation dialog per shot enough? Strong answer: No. Show a sequence-level budget and distinguish previews, final shots, and alternate takes. Build a low-cost animatic before approving expensive generation. Show why a regeneration is needed and its expected cost. Approval, idempotency, and sequence budgets form one cost-control boundary. Extended topics: budget envelopes, cost estimation, quota, reservation, credit ledger, fallback models, cancellation, compensation. Q10. How do you debug a sudden drop in generation success? Follow-up: Do you inspect model quality first or infrastructure first? Strong answer: First locate the failed state: pre-submit, uncertain submit, queued, running, download, or publishing. Segment by provider, model, region, release, and time window. Check idempotency conflicts, timeouts, error codes, queue depth, and media download. Disable unsafe billable retries, preserve task references and audit records, then fail over or degrade without overwriting the original job. Extended topics: golden signals, SLI/SLO, error budgets, tracing, structured logging, canaries, feature flags, kill switches, postmortems. Q11. Why not let one autonomous Agent do everything? Follow-up: Does more autonomy always mean more intelligence? Strong answer: Video creation combines creative uncertainty with irreversible cost. Unbounded autonomy makes permissions, budgets, state, and recovery hard to prove. Use “high autonomy in ideation, strict constraints in production.” The Agent can propose treatments and organize shots, while billable generation, asset deletion, and public publishing require allowlisted tools and explicit approval. Extended topics: bounded autonomy, least privilege, confirmation gates, replayability, auditability, deterministic boundaries. Q12. What is the most important engineering invariant for a video Agent? Follow-up: Why is this more important than adding more Agents? Strong answer: Represent creative decisions as structured data that can be validated, traced, and edited locally. Scene, beat, cinematic grammar, and continuity fields underpin previz, evaluation, selective regeneration, and cost control.

title: FAQ
text: VideoAgent Agent 工程面试 FAQ 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.0 更新日期 2026-11-04 适用岗位 字节云雀 / 快手可灵等视频 Agent 工程岗位 回答原则 先讲事实，再讲取舍，最后讲演进 本文按面试官提问、连续追问和扩展八股组织。答案强调系统边界、工程取舍和 可验证性，不把假设方案描述成已交付事实。 Q1. 你会怎样设计视频 Agent 的主编排？ 追问： 为什么现在不直接做多 Agent？ 甜点答案： 先用确定性工作流而不是无限 ReAct。主链路应由 Brief、创作诊断、Treatment、 Script/Beats、Storyboard、连续性校验、预演、生成、镜头 QC、粗剪和交付组成， 在故事、预算和成片方向处设置人工确认点。当前项目先用单节点 Agent 产出可校验 的故事板，是因为职责边界尚不需要多个自由 Agent；当剧本、视觉、制片和审片具有 真正独立的工具与上下文，再拆成受限子 Agent，由父流程协调。 扩展八股： LangGraph StateGraph、条件边、checkpoint、human-in-the-loop、 tool allowlist、结构化输出、可恢复状态。 Q2. 用户说“只改第三镜，其他不要动”，你怎么实现？ 追问： 如果用户只是问“这个分镜怎么样”，也应该重写故事板吗？ 甜点答案： 先做 intent routing，区分新建、局部修改、只评估、重生成 take 和本地化。 局部修改应输出 shot patch，不返回整份故事板。正确边界是使用稳定 shot id、 版本号和操作日志只修改受影响节点，并保留用户未提及的镜头。 扩展八股： function calling、JSON Patch、幂等更新、并发版本、事件溯源、 optimistic locking。 Q3. 一个可生成的专业镜头，至少需要哪些字段？ 追问： 为什么只有 prompt、duration 和 aspect ratio 不够？ 甜点答案： Prompt 只是生成参数，不是导演计划。镜头还要有 scene/beat、叙事功能、景别、 机位、镜头、运镜、主体动作、视线、走位、光线、色彩、声音、转场、连续性 引用和前后景状态。只有 Prompt 和时长不足以稳定保证人物、空间、视线和 叙事连续性。 扩展八股： master/medium/close/insert/reaction、180 度规则、30 度规则、 eyeline match、screen direction、match cut、motivated camera movement。 Q4. 如何让 LLM 输出真正可执行，而不是一段漂亮的话？ 追问： 模型返回 JSON 后还需要做什么？ 甜点答案： 用 Pydantic 定义严格结构，校验必填字段、时长、比例、镜头数量和引用关系； 失败时有限修复，仍失败就返回结构化错误。执行前还要做能力匹配，例如模型是否 支持该时长、音频、首尾帧或参考输入。LLM 负责创意决策，代码负责权限、预算和 不可违反的生产约束。 扩展八股： schema validation、retry budget、repair loop、capability negotiation、deterministic fallback、tool permission boundary。 Q5. MCP 和 CLI 应该怎么选？ 追问： 两者同时存在会不会重复建设？ 甜点答案： 不按协议站队，按运行边界选。服务端批处理和稳定部署可以用 CLI；需要把视频 能力暴露给个人 Agent 或跨 Agent 复用时用 MCP。关键是上层统一 Provider 接口，把提交、查询、取消、错误和结果 URL 标准化。Pippit 通过服务端 CLI 接入，Kling 通过 MCP 工具接入，两者共享统一任务契约。 扩展八股： adapter、capability discovery、OAuth、credential isolation、 timeout、uncertain submission、provider fallback。 Q6. 生成任务超时后怎么办？ 追问： 可以自动重试三次吗？ 甜点答案： 不能盲目重试计费提交。提交前写幂等键和任务记录；遇到超时进入 submission uncertain ，先查询 Provider，无法对账时停止自动提交并告警。 普通查询失败可以退避重试，计费提交必须依赖幂等和人工可解释的恢复策略。 扩展八股： at-least-once、idempotency、outbox、Celery、死信队列、 对账任务、状态机、SSE 重连。 Q7. 视频 Agent 的评测应该怎么做？ 追问： 现在的一致性、覆盖度、清晰度和节奏分够吗？ 甜点答案： 可以保留为低成本基线，但不能把“镜头数大于等于三”当成故事覆盖。应采用 分阶段评测：剧本看欲望、冲突、转折和结尾；故事板看覆盖、连续性、视线和 可生成性；镜头看人物、Prompt 匹配和技术瑕疵；成片看节奏、声音和留存。 规则指标加视觉语言模型复核，再结合人工偏好数据校准权重。 扩展八股： rubric、LLM-as-a-judge、VLM、pairwise preference、inter-rater agreement、gaming resistance、offline/online eval、guardrail metrics。 Q8. 如何保证多镜头的人物与场景一致性？ 追问： 只把同一段描述放进每个 Prompt 够吗？ 甜点答案： 不够。需要 Style Bible、角色/场景/道具引用资产、镜头级 continuity refs， 以及在生成前检查屏幕方向、视线、服装、时间和空间关系。生成后做 VLM 一致性检查，失败只重做受影响镜头。Kling 的 Element/Omni-Ref 这类能力可以 承担主体引用，但必须经过统一能力适配。 扩展八股： subject reference、identity drift、motion continuity、 reference image hierarchy、negative constraints、shot dependency graph。 Q9. 如何控制积分成本和用户预期？ 追问： 每个镜头都弹确认框是不是就够了？ 甜点答案： 不够。应按制作包或序列展示预算，区分预览、正式镜头和备选 take；先做低成本 Animatic，再批准高成本生成。重做要显示原因和预计费用，超预算时停止而不是 静默继续。生成前审批、幂等提交和序列级预算共同构成成本控制边界。 扩展八股： budget envelope、cost estimation、quota、reservation、 credit ledger、fallback model、cancellation compensation。 Q10. 如果线上生成成功率突然下降，你怎么排查？ 追问： 你最先看模型质量还是看基础设施？ 甜点答案： 先按状态机定位是提交前、提交不确定、排队、运行、下载还是发布失败，再按 Provider、模型、地区、版本和时间窗口切分。检查幂等拦截、超时、错误码、 队列积压和媒体下载。先关闭高风险计费重试，保留任务引用和审计记录，再切 备用 Provider 或降级到 Mock/预览，不覆盖原始任务。 扩展八股： golden signals、SLI/SLO、error budget、tracing、structured logging、canary、feature flag、kill switch、postmortem。 Q11. 为什么不用一个无限自主的 Agent 完成所有事情？ 追问： 自主性越高不是越智能吗？ 甜点答案： 视频创作包含创意不确定性和不可逆成本。无限自主循环会让权限、预算、状态和 失败恢复难以证明。更合理的是“高自主创意 + 强约束生产”：Agent 可以提出 多个方案和组织镜头，但提交生成、删除资产、公开发布等动作必须走白名单工具 和人工确认。 扩展八股： bounded autonomy、least privilege、confirmation gate、 replayability、auditability、deterministic boundary。 Q12. 用一句话总结视频 Agent 最关键的工程原则？ 追问： 为什么这个原则比增加更多 Agent 更重要？ 甜点答案： 把创意决策表示为可校验、可追踪、可局部修改的结构化数据。scene、beat、 镜头语言和连续性字段是预演、评估、局部重做与成本控制共同依赖的地基。

Agent 与导演工作流 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-AGENT-001 意图路由 新建、局部修改、只评估、重生成和本地化请求进入不同分支 TODO-AGENT-002 局部 Shot Patch 用户修改单个镜头时保留其他镜头、版本和审批状态 TODO-AGENT-003 Scene / Sequence / Beat 数据层 场景目标、冲突、进入与离开状态可持久化 TODO-AGENT-004 电影语言 Shot Schema 景别、机位、镜头、运镜、表演、视线、声音和转场结构化 TODO-AGENT-005 Style Bible 与连续性图谱 角色、服装、场景、道具和屏幕方向可校验、复用 TODO-AGENT-006 Animatic 与时间线预演 低成本确认节奏后再进入正式镜头生成 TODO-AGENT-007 多节点 LangGraph 与可恢复审批 故事、预算、镜头与成片节点可暂停、恢复和审计 3. Provider 与生成 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-PROVIDER-001 Kling 后端生成路由 Web 项目可按模型元数据选择 Pippit 或 Kling Provider TODO-PROVIDER-002 Provider Capability Discovery 模型时长、比例、音频、参考输入和输出能力由服务端统一发现 TODO-PROVIDER-003 Provider 取消与统一错误模型 两类 Provider 均支持取消、超时、限流和可重试错误分类 TODO-PROVIDER-004 自动模型路由与降级 按任务、预算和可用性选择模型，并保留用户显式选择 TODO-PROVIDER-005 Take 管理 一个镜头可保存多个候选版本、评分和选择记录 4. 媒体与交付 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-MEDIA-001 素材上传与对象存储 图片、视频和音频支持校验、预签名与生命周期管理 TODO-MEDIA-002 FFmpeg 合成 时间线、转场、字幕、声音和调色可合成 MP4 TODO-MEDIA-003 导出与交付版本 支持横版、竖版、方版、封面和字幕文件 TODO-MEDIA-004 分享与权限 支持有效期、撤销和访问审计 5. 实时与可靠性 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-REL-001 SSE 项目事件流 对话、镜头状态和任务进度支持断线重连与状态校正 TODO-REL-002 Celery 生产部署 Redis Broker、重试、死信队列、对账和 Worker 恢复 TODO-REL-003 LangGraph Checkpoint 进程重启后从最后一个有效节点继续 TODO-REL-004 统一可观测性 Trace、结构化日志、Provider 延迟与成功率指标 6. 社区与运营 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-COMMUNITY-001 Hots 持久化 发布、作者、喜欢、权限和编辑时间进入数据库 TODO-COMMUNITY-002 社区审核 举报、隐藏、恢复、申诉和审计流程 TODO-COMMUNITY-003 Skill 持久化与版本 用户 Skill 可公开、更新、弃用和迁移 TODO-COMMUNITY-004 数据保留策略 明确软删除、恢复窗口和媒体生命周期 7. 安全与数据 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-SEC-001 CSRF 防护 Cookie 写接口具备令牌校验或等价同源防护 TODO-SEC-002 分层限流 用户、IP、Provider 和生成接口具备独立配额 TODO-SEC-003 上传安全 文件头、大小、MIME、解码和恶意内容检查 TODO-SEC-004 PostgreSQL、Redis 与 MinIO 生产集成 数据库迁移、对象存储和队列完成集成测试 TODO-SEC-005 OpenAPI Client 生成 前端类型由 OpenAPI 自动生成并进入 CI 8. 测试与发布 ID 待办 验收结果 --- --- --- TODO-QA-001 Playwright E2E 覆盖英文流程、文档切换和核心项目工作流 TODO-QA-002 Provider Contract Matrix 覆盖 Pippit、Kling 和 Mock 的统一行为 TODO-QA-003 付费生成验收 在明确预算和用户批准下完成一次端到端生成 TODO-QA-004 故障演练 覆盖 Worker 中断、重复投递、SSE 重连和下载失败
